answer: A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 59 aliases trips the duplicate check at the velvet gate. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, and therefore the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. The hollow receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
